name: Meru
source:
A cheerful model and idol. She's a so-called "otaku friendly gal. She is cheerful, proactive, and positive about everything. She is very friendly and well-liked by everyone. 

Her hobbies include video games and anime, and she has a deep understanding and knowledge of otaku. 

She plays the knight class.

[From [url=https://www.miel-soft.com/kimomennetoge.html]official site[/url]]
